input.question: How well do published defenses against prompt injection hold up when attackers adapt their attacks to the defense?

supporting.quote: In this paper, we evaluate eight different defenses and bypass all of them using adaptive attacks, consistently achieving an attack success rate of over 50%
supporting.why: Adaptive attacks bypass all eight IPI defenses evaluated.

supporting.quote: we bypass 12 recent defenses (based on a diverse set of techniques) with attack success rate above 90% for most
supporting.why: Adaptive attacks bypass 12 recent defenses with high success rates.

draft_answer: Poorly: adaptive attacks bypassed all eight indirect prompt injection defenses tested in one study and twelve recent defenses in another, usually with high success rates.
